Extract Gate 0 (claim + measurement readiness) tables

Source: R/gate0_viz.R
gate0_tables.Rd

Helper to extract the normalized claim specification produced by Gate 0A and the measurement readiness summary produced by Gate 0B.

Usage

gate0_tables(x)

Arguments

x

(AutoIML | AutoIMLResult) An AutoIML runner or a completed result.

Value

list() with:

  • claim_card: one-row data.table summary (Gate 0A).

  • claim: full normalized claim specification list (Gate 0A).

  • measurement_card: one-row data.table summary (Gate 0B; may be NULL).

  • missingness: per-feature missingness table (Gate 0B; may be NULL).
